purpose: Submission-facing editorial cleanup and claim narrowing after freezing the integrated theory and implementation baseline.

editorial_repairs.hierarchy_consistency: Removed the remaining Theoretical Ecology guidance that said to keep four headline theorems; the canonical hierarchy remains one principal reachability theorem, one supporting extremal theorem, one diagnostic theorem, and one mechanistic proposition.
editorial_repairs.priority_search_status: Final search completed. It recovered formal information-fitness predecessors that the first polish pass underweighted, especially Moffett and Eckford 2022, which already derives minimum mutual-information requirements for target growth and selection.
editorial_repairs.information_theory_boundary: The manuscript now explicitly disclaims novelty for the fitness value of information, minimum mutual-information requirements for fitness or selection, and generic evolutionary information thresholds. The principal result is stated instead as a minimum or Pareto-minimal finite deterministic decision/separation structure over represented alternatives, declared cues, and irreducible obligations.
editorial_repairs.bibliography_sync: Added Donaldson-Matasci et al. 2010, Rivoire and Leibler 2011, Moffett and Eckford 2022, and de Boer and Hogeweg 2010; completed the ICALP 2009 Part I / LNCS 5555 / pages 210-221 metadata for Chakaravarthy et al.; synchronized the manuscript reference list with citations used in the prose.
editorial_repairs.submission_control: Replaced obsolete PR #6 merge instructions with a frozen-baseline submission policy and kept side branches such as temporal-routing and inverse-diagnostics outside the canonical manuscript unless deliberately developed as separate work.

claim_boundary.principal_result: required local dynamical regime -> required adaptive/fixed structural gap -> minimum or Pareto-minimal finite deterministic decision/separation structure over (n,m,E)
claim_boundary.explicit_prior_art: minimum Shannon or mutual-information requirements for target fitness/selection are prior art
claim_boundary.supporting_result: extremally sharp structural-temporal envelope; not a point prediction of realized variance and not a generic fitness-value-of-information theorem
claim_boundary.diagnostic_result: model-compatible complex local mode forces feedback existence within the generalized model, not feedback magnitude
claim_boundary.mechanistic_proposition: neutral cancellation stasis and attractive restoring stasis are distinct
